start: Speak to Cormac in Auchrie after Ffion allows entry to Wyrmscraig

prerequisites.transport: Player-owned raft or skiff; sloop cannot enter the narrow cavern; disembark solo
prerequisites.equipment: Combat preparation for three level-69 trolls and the level-270 Mad Angel; iron pickaxe/chisel available locally

stage_flow: Ffion at dock and Cormac in Auchrie
Muriel, tent tools, sunstone monolith and chiseled sunstone core
Keenan's hat on southern coast; Cormac report
Solo player-owned raft/skiff into Wyrmscraig Cavern
Three mountain trolls, rockfall removal and Mortimer Slayer Master access
Broken golem core replacement, cipher chest (right-left-down-down), ancient core turned into key
Optional mine-and-climb cave/cathedral shortcut at 54 Agility
Climb to cathedral, defeat the Mad Angel, examine Keenan and read note
Solve changing cathedral exit lock and report to Cormac

partial_unlocks.unlock.grace.cavern: After reporting the southern hat to Cormac
partial_unlocks.unlock.grace.mortimer: After dealing with all three trolls and talking to Mortimer
partial_unlocks.unlock.grace.golem_door: After sunstone core replaces the failed golem core

combat.mountain_trolls: Three level-69 trolls in multicombat; explicit planned-success check, no fixed combat XP budget
combat.mad_angel: Level-270 boss weak to crush; avoid sword windup, bouncing projectiles and charged lightning; attack speed increases at 255 HP. Planned-success, not guaranteed.

optional_deferred: Postquest 48 Construction bank chest requiring 2 lead bars, 8 mahogany planks, 32 mithril nails, hammer, saw and the boss's sunstone crystal; separate supply/cost and Construction XP model needed.
Actual consumable necklace of passage, Slayer ring and Ardeaglais teleport item routes; completion flag is produced, but teleport edges not fabricated.
Sunstone Golem Crafting's repeatable, potentially unbounded XP and Mad Angel repeat farming excluded from finite quest reward.
remaining_review_gaps: Wyrmscraig pier, island boat canal, narrow cavern dock, cathedral exit lock and optional shortcut tiles are estimates; interior timings require live calibration.

The inventory model has no generic pickaxe predicate, so the draft path uses the available Wyrmscraig iron pickaxe. Other pickaxe tiers can be substituted only after a future general item-family feature.

The raft unlock is an existing abstract stand-in for raft/skiff ownership. There is no distinct boat-type or passenger-occupancy predicate, though the requirements and narrow-passage restriction are recorded.
Cavern/boat return behavior after boss deaths may be unreliable, including reported missing boat and misplaced deathpile; recover at Wyrmscraig dock or Red Rock/Corsair Cove as appropriate.
Actual Mad Angel combat supplies, prayer switching costs, deaths and incidental XP cannot be deterministically debited from this noncombat optimizer.
Confirm whether the ancient sunstone key is truly consumed at staircase, whether the dull core can be dropped, and the sunstone crystal's post-quest retained/reclaim handling.
The cipher chest has a static first code, whereas cathedral exit lock tumbler values change. No solver logic is embedded for the variable lock.
Boostability of the optional Agility shortcut and exact spawn positions for hammer and chisel require independent game check.
The quest helper does not pin the Wyrmscraig port tile or outer cathedral gate, so approximate candidates were used for graph connection.
